This sidebar uses Liberation Sans for user interface elements and notifications. Sans-serif
fonts provide excellent clarity for supplementary information and interactive elements.
The following code example demonstrates how different font families can coexist within the same document
while maintaining visual harmony and functional distinctions.

Technical Specifications:
Sans-Serif: Liberation Sans (UI elements, headers)
Serif:      Liberation

Serif (body text, articles)  
Monospace:  Liberation Mono (code, data tables)
Modern:     Open Sans
This mixed approach allows each font family to serve its optimal purpose: serif fonts enhance reading flow
in long-form content, sans-serif fonts provide clarity in interface elements, and monospace fonts ensure
perfect alignment in code and data presentations.
